author: KEXP
description: Liam Shortall, the creative force behind the musical project corto.alto, floats listeners into a liminal space brimming with intricate and improvisational jazz rhythms. Live on KEXP with host Larry Mizell Jr., he shares a performance of the unreleased track "BULLETPROOF" and more.
title: corto.alto performs "BULLETPROOF" & more Live on KEXP
